answer: Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the knoll of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The design leans on staked peer review with spot checks, reduced by each unverified claim, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. Every claim climbs the cedar of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the reef re-runs the work instead of trusting the label.
